[ASSISTANT_SAID] Realistic depictions of landscape changed over different art movements due to the evolution of artistic styles and techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Renaissance: Artists began to show more interest in representing the natural world accurately, utilizing techniques like linear perspective and atmospheric perspective.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Baroque: Artists focused on dramatic effects and dynamic compositions, using intense light and shadow to create movement and drama.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Romanticism: The movement emphasized emotional experience of nature, using bold colors, loose brushwork, and exaggerated forms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Impressionism: Artists aimed to capture fleeting effects of light and atmosphere, using quick brushwork and bright colors for immediacy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Expressionism: Artists conveyed inner emotional states through distorted forms and colors to evoke turmoil, anxiety, or joy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Contemporary art: Artists explore new ways of depicting nature, focusing on ecological issues and experimenting with digital and multimedia techniques.
